scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @job-inbox/backend" "npm run dev -w @job-inbox/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @job-inbox/backend && npm run build -w @job-inbox/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @job-inbox/backend && npm run typecheck -w @job-inbox/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:check -w @job-inbox/backend && npm run lint:check -w @job-inbox/frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint -w @job-inbox/backend && npm run lint -w @job-inbox/frontend
scripts.format: npm run format -w @job-inbox/backend && npm run format -w @job-inbox/frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w @job-inbox/backend && npm run format:check -w @job-inbox/frontend
